title: Squash realm minigame
problem: Squash realm minigame: squash2 writes digit 2 (code wrote 0), so all 10 Squash combos can happen like Fruit and Tarot. Playtest-confirmed bug

release_notes.intended: All of the Squash minigame's combinations can come up, as with the Fruit and Tarot minigames.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, one slot was recorded wrongly, so some combinations could never happen.
